title: Marketing: pi-durable, durability and cost pages
description:

Website PRs are reviewed and merged by the owner only; agents never merge them. The marketing agent's PR is on branch marketing/durability-and-cost (no PR exists yet as of 2026-10-13; reference it here once it does, find with gh pr list --repo AnthusAI/Chattic.us-web --head marketing/durability-and-cost).

## Rules
- Describe only what exists today. The vision is labelled 'Coming soon'.
- Any later cost claim depends on cost epic chatticus-8c857b.
- No third-party product names for Chatticus parts; v1 LLM is OpenAI.

## Definition of done
Pages, navigation and the updates entry are merged by the owner, truthful against develop, and the cost page follow-up is tracked.
